items.title: Five equivalent tests for geometric reducedness via purely inseparable extensions and closures
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives five equivalent conditions for a finite type algebra over a field to be geometrically reduced, ranging over finite purely inseparable extensions, the p-closure, the perfect closure and the algebraic closure (statement lines 10641-10655). The proof does not check each implication: it orders the conditions using the embeddings between the relevant field extensions so that one direction collapses, and proves the remaining implication at the generic point via the separability criterion (proof lines 10657-10695). Choosing that ordering of the five fields is what makes four of the implications immediate. H2.
